name: Nix
description: Install Nix and prepare the development environment declared in a dev.nix file when the container is created or started

version.description: Select or enter a Nix version to install

file.description: Path of the dev.nix file, relative to the workspace folder. Nothing is prepared when the file does not exist.

channel.description: Default nixpkgs channel when dev.nix does not set `channel`. Accepts stable-<release>, unstable, a nixpkgs branch name or a nixpkgs commit.

allowUnfree.description: Allow packages with an unfree license

autoRebuild.description: Rebuild the environment on container start when dev.nix has changed since the last build
